annotations.title: Set up or update the business quoting profile

description: Create a business, or update its saved settings (call with trade_key to update). Saves the rates and rules every quote uses: day and hour rates, labourer rate, materials markup, VAT registration and number, CIS, deposit rule, validity, payment terms, standard exclusions, brand colour, logo (https link or base64; PNG or JPEG for the PDF), quote number prefix, price book. On first call returns trade_key ONCE: it is shown only once and every other tool needs it. Also returns nero_trade_ref, the same identity the Nero Work exchange and Spark Pack use. Money in pounds.

brand_colour.description: Hex colour, for example #0B5FFF. If a logo is given and no colour, one is taken from the logo.

company_name.description: Registered company name if a limited company.

day_rate.description: The trade's own charge-out rate per day, pounds, before VAT.

deposit.description: Deposit rule. basis percent (with percent), fixed (with amount in pounds), materials (deposit equals the materials total), or none. no_deposit_under: no deposit on quotes below this total in pounds.

display_name.description: Business name customers see. Required on first setup.

hour_rate.description: Per hour, pounds. If only one of day_rate and hour_rate is set the other is worked out from hours_per_day.

labourer_day_rate.description: Charge-out day rate for a mate, labourer or apprentice.

licence_body.description: Scheme or registration body: niceic, napit, elecsa, stroma, gas_safe, oftec, hetas, fensa, certass, trustmark, nfrc, fmb, other.

licence_number.description: Registration number with that body (Gas Safe number for gas engineers).

logo_base64.description: The logo file as base64, instead of logo_url.

logo_url.description: https link to the logo (PNG best, JPEG fine, SVG shows on the phone page only). Under 400 KB.

materials_markup_percent.description: Added to what materials cost the trade. Default 15.

payment_terms.description: Shown on every quote, for example "Deposit to book, balance on completion by bank transfer."

price_display.description: itemised (default) shows quantity and price per line; sections shows one price per section (labour, materials) with the lines listed.

price_items.description: Materials the trade buys often, saved to their price book. Each: code (short id, optional), description, unit, unit_cost (pounds, what they pay), cost_includes_vat, markup_percent (optional, overrides the default).

quote_prefix.description: Letters before the quote number, for example BLE gives BLE-0001. Default from the business initials.

standard_exclusions.description: Things this business never includes unless stated, shown on every quote.

trade_key.description: Omit to create a new business. Give it to update an existing one (only the fields you send change).

use_suggested_exclusions.description: Adds a short set of common exclusions for the trade(s), for example plastering after chasing for electricians.

vat_registered.description: Required on first setup. If false, no VAT is ever added.
